text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yo-yo, Trai-chan. Remember that Umatter 
post I showed you before?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend's Umatter. It's a hobby account 
she uses to gather information from 
followers and verify it.
choice_data_list: I remember, but is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I got some new tips after that. They all 
sound pretty interesting, you know.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out to investigate now, you're 
coming too, right Trainie?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"During the previous investigation... 
Transcend tried to press on despite a 
swarm of bees being present."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once her curiosity is ignited, she doesn't 
care if she's walking into danger. I need 
to keep a close eye on her...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, of course.
Yeah, of course.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Then the "Rumored Scope" 
Investigation Team is ready to roll~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, boss. ..."Make the flavor wild, 
and serve it double-quick."

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ho... You know the password, do you? Hold 
on a second.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Order up! It's our secret menu item, the 
"Super Sweet Chocolate Starchy Sauce 
Ramen"!
choice_data_list: W-What does it taste like, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, the fun part is tasting it to find 
out. So with that said, itadakimasu!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list: I-It definitely has a unique flavor...

I-It's certainly a unique flavor, isn't 
it...

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text:
You sure know a lot before the public 
reveal~! Yeah, an albino baby raccoon dog 
really was born.

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text:
"Since you're here, care to take a look? I 
want to get them used to guests before 
their big debut."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ohh...! It really is pure white.
choice_data_list: So cute...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Animal lovers would probably really enjoy 
this topic.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it feels kinda divine somehow. 
I'll say a little prayer as thanks.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Blessings upon you, blessings upon you.

text_block_list.name: Professor
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku... Indeed. Just as you say, this 
laboratory is developing "that"...

text_block_list.name: Professor
text_block_list.text:
"However... now that thou knowest, thou 
understandest what must be done, correct?"

text_block_list.name: Professor
text_block_list.text: "You're gonna help out! With this—"

text_block_list.name: Professor
text_block_list.text:
For a test run of the "Ultra-High-Speed 
Jet Boots"! I needed data for the final 
adjustments, you see~!
choice_data_list: Huh, are you sure...企?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh! In that case, wanna race and see who's 
faster?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I spent the entire day engrossed 
in investigating the rumors...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Is it that time already~? Still, looks 
like we have time to check out one more 
place."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
For now, what caught my interest are 'The 
Illusory Urban Relaxation Spot' and 'The 
Mysterious Cafe Where a Monster Lurks', I 
suppose?
choice_data_list: What else is there?
What other ones are there?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... "An Umamusume picking street 
races" and "New Umalator software under 
development"...
choice_data_list: I see, I see. Anything else?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list: ...Tran?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Haha, ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah... nah, it's nothing? Just thinking how 
you were looking totally radiant just now, 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Me... sparkling?
Me... sparkling?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Eyes sparkling. Just like a kid 
standing in front of a toy store.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hey, how was your day today?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That was fun, wasn't it? Thrilling, wasn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thoughts like "this might be dangerous~"— 
had honestly just flown right out of your 
head, hadn't they~?
choice_data_list: Ah, I had so much fun thanks to you
Yeah, I had so much fun thanks to you.

I-It's not like I'm excited or anything, 
got it?!

I-It's not like I'm excited or anything, 
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thoughts like "this might be dangerous~"— 
had honestly just flown right out of your 
head, hadn't they~?
choice_data_list: Ah, I had so much fun thanks to you
Yeah, I had so much fun thanks to you.

I-It's not like I'm excited or anything, 
got it?!

I-It's not like I'm excited or anything, 
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Right~~~~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainy, let's pick. How we're 
gonna wrap up today, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, once the two decided on their 
target, they set off for the final 
investigation of the day.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's that supposed to mean~! If 
you're gonna say that, then I'll—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I wanted to investigate with 
you or anything, Trainer-chan!
choice_data_list:
...*pfft*! What was that line, 
seriously...!
...*pfft*! What was that line just now...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "No, no~! You started it first, Trainie!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, playfully joking around with each 
other, we headed off to our final 
investigation of the day.
